metadata.title: Taylor Formulas for H-structures
metadata.abstract: We give a uniform second-order Taylor formula for tensorial Riemannian $H$-structures in Riemannian normal coordinates whose initial frame is $H$-adapted. For a defining multi-tensor $\xi$ with intrinsic torsion $T$, the linear coefficient is $T_q\diamond\xi$, and the quadratic coefficient features the covariant derivative of $T$, its iterated diamond action, and curvature. The formula applies componentwise to tensors of arbitrary type and recovers the known $G_2$ and $\operatorname{Spin}(7)$ expansions. We also give the almost Hermitian specialisation and prove that vanishing of the complete second-order torsion contribution forces the intrinsic torsion to vanish at the centre of the coordinates.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 在初始标架适配H的黎曼正规坐标中，给出张量型黎曼H结构统一的二阶Taylor公式。定义多张量ξ的线性项为内蕴挠率T作用于ξ，二次项涉及∇T、迭代作用与曲率。公式逐分量适用于任意张量型，恢复G₂和Spin(7)情形，并给出几乎Hermitian特化。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一多类特殊结构的二阶公式，并证明完整二阶挠率贡献消失迫使坐标中心挠率为零。
analysis.limitations: 结论是局部二阶展开；刚性要求完整二阶挠率贡献消失，不能从个别系数为零推出。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露ChatGPT用于LaTeX组织排版、语言编辑、记号与约定检查和数学一致性审查，具体还包括澄清挠率消失论证、区分坐标正规化与度量数据、发展Spin(7)部分的显式代数例子。记录writing、verification、proofs和exploration；声明未把主构造或核心思路明确归给模型。所述精确计算检查未具体说明由模型完成，不据此额外推断计算用途。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.10968v1 · PDF 第11页Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the manuscript preparation process，全文11页。
